title: Show extracted receipt fields after capture
userStory: As a user, after I confirm a captured receipt, the app extracts and shows its fields (vendor, date, net, VAT, gross, category) and flags anything that needs review.
acceptanceCriteria: After a receipt is confirmed in CaptureScreen, App.js runs extraction via the existing extractReceipt/processReceipts lib (injectable vision client) and renders the six fields.
When extraction marks the receipt needs-review (VAT mismatch or low confidence), the UI shows a clear needs-review indicator.
The capture-to-extract wiring lives in a testable helper (pure function or src/lib module) unit-testable without a React runtime; App.js calls it.
npm test passes: helper covered (clean receipt shows fields; flagged receipt surfaces needs-review) and App.js source asserts the fields render.
